finding: Children breastfed for a longer time had higher FEV(1), FEV(1)/FVC, and FEF75 z-score values at 11 years of age compared to children breastfed for a shorter time, suggesting a protective effect of breastfeeding on airways.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered as a confounder and was adjusted for in the multivariable analysis examining the association of breastfeeding and respiratory outcomes.
